ai_summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited announced the immediate resignation of Shri Salil Bawa, President - Investor Relation and a Senior Management Personnel, effective September 14, 2026. This swift departure, with his notice period waived and only a vague "as discussed" reason provided, represents a material impact due to the loss of a key investor communication leader. The lack of a clear public explanation for such a critical senior management exit could be perceived as a red flag regarding leadership stability and transparency.
